meaning: Ledger revenue net of its deductions: minus the company amounts of journal lines on the system account subtree revenue (which holds the revenue deduction accounts), closing and migration entries excluded as ADR-0049 rules 6-7 (ADR-0060 rule 4).
Trade discounts, returns, allowances and other deductions from revenue, from the journal lines of the system account subtree revenue_deduction; closing and migration entries excluded.
Cost of goods sold as posted to the system account cost_of_goods_sold; closing and migration entries excluded; field class cost (ADR-0060 rule 4).
Net revenue minus cost of goods sold, computed after aggregation; field class margin.
Gross profit as a percent of net revenue, computed after aggregation and recomputed for totals; field class margin.
Selling and administrative expense from the journal lines of those system account subtrees; closing and migration entries excluded.
Debit turnover in company currency, storno lines included with their sign; requires the system account dimension; migration entries excluded, closing entries included, as ADR-0049 rule 6's turnover.

Credit turnover in company currency as a positive figure, storno lines included with their sign; requires the system account dimension; migration entries excluded, closing entries included, as ADR-0049 rule 6's turnover.
Debit minus credit turnover in company currency; requires the system account dimension; migration entries excluded, closing entries included, as ADR-0049 rule 6's turnover.
Closing balance per system account at the end of each period bucket, carried forward through periods without movement; never summed over periods (ADR-0050 rule 53; ADR-0060 rule 12).
Posted net amounts of sales invoice lines in company currency, minus sales return and credit note lines.
Net line amounts in the document currency, signed; requires the currency dimension or a filter on one currency.
Quantities sold in the inventory unit, returns negative; requires the item or product dimension or a filter on one.
Cost of the quantities sold as the lines carry it; field class cost.
Net company amount minus cost of the lines; field class margin.
Sales margin as a percent of the sales net amount, computed after aggregation; field class margin.
Distinct posted sales invoices and corrections behind the lines.
Distinct customers with posted sales lines; totals are recomputed from rows.
Posted net amounts of purchase invoice lines in company currency, minus purchase return and purchase credit note lines.
Net purchase line amounts in the document currency; requires the currency dimension or a filter on one currency.
Quantities purchased in the inventory unit; requires the item or product dimension or a filter on one.
Open amount of receivable open items in company currency, at the current snapshot (ADR-0026).
Open receivable amount past its due date at the business date.
Open amount of payable open items in company currency on their natural side, at the current snapshot.
Open payable amount past its due date at the business date.
Open items at the current snapshot.
Stock on hand in the inventory unit at the current snapshot; requires the item or product dimension or a filter on one.
Stock value in company currency at the current snapshot; field class cost.
Quantities of posted material document lines that increase stock.
Quantities of posted material document lines that decrease stock.
Signed values of posted material document lines; field class cost.
Good quantities received from production orders in the inventory unit.
Scrapped quantities reported on production orders in the inventory unit.
Distinct production orders with posted output or scrap.
Actual minus target cost per order, period and variance category, read from production's stored split (ADR-0035 rule 15; ADR-0060 rule 19); field class cost.
